blind: Signed root captures separate from two-arm sealed outcomes. Publish a digest of each outcome without its numbers to the fitter, and keep outcomes unopened by predictor until the fitted weights or explicit final refusal to fit are frozen. Then report same-sign ranking by seat and signed prediction errors including ties, with no filtering. No promotion, no strength claims.
features: Use the actual scoring leaves of each candidate, legal simulated roster (both seats), five scalars and quantized 54-plane encoded estimate bound to source root and candidate/roll; opponent hidden carbon truth, actual future actions and terminal outcome never enter the predictor. Start with frozen native scalar value v, no intercept. R=299-leaf_step, d=shortest 15x15 toroidal Manhattan distance to nearest own base. For each player's positive-cargo collectors, lost=sum cargo [d>R or R<=0]; transit=sum cargo*(d/R) over 0<=d<=R,R>0. Features x1=(lost_other - lost_us)/3000, x2=(transit_other - transit_us)/3000. This proxies delivery time and inventory exposure; no claim that reachable cargo is realized. Exact terminal leaves keep their authoritative value for every arm and have zero residual. Each final nonterminal row evaluates v+w1*x1+w2*x2. Mean equally across the original matching roll indices, subtract runner-up from first. Do not train on independent unit actions.

Preserve the private state/real root cost of V2; correct its committed root intent per intervention. Both then continue with identical V2 and original native public policy to official score. Store per-arm score and return via native _terminal(margin); target is first minus second. Record all errors and branch timings. Private historical entropy and per-tick cost unrecorded; use common reconstructed private streams and local cost calibration; local public-call timing is diagnostic.
runtime: One fixed CPU 3. During conditioning replay both signed public histories and recorded orders to t248. Reconstruct own private history with archived executed orders. Initialize independent role RNGs from registered policy_rng (+37*physical seat, uint32); simulate consumed root-policy draws. Original intended seed None and temperature 1, original wall deadline .58s. Calibrate local costs with first 3 public calls; true historic clocks and RNG unavailable. Trace verified longest depth8 score, complete and matching roll set. Exact ties retained, <2 distinct orders => skip with receipt. Both branches start from identical post-call native costs/RNGs and the single shared native opponent root command. Install learner-selected arm as actual private tracker intent. After one changed root, natural V2/true-opponent continuation, all actions and clocks, official score incl extinction. No repeat.
selection_reason: Retrospective selection. The previously exposed losing V2 seat 1 was ahead by 11.59 in public cash at t248, before divergence. Include the same terrain, seat 0, at that same step. Both original game outcomes already known. No fit, treatment tuning, weight selection, new maps, or replacement. This set represents one physical map.
selection_rule: All 12 tickets are fixed once. At each only the full unmodified V2 public root search is allowed, .58 native deadline, original R=M=MMAX=1. Use distinct surviving joint orders with complete H=8 on the same roll set. Sort by native score descending, tie by native alive order. First and second distinct qualified orders are the arms. Keep exact ties; fewer than two or incomplete depth => no pair, no substitute. A root without near-terminal relevance remains eligible.
